newsitem.title: USA: Signet up on takeover rumors - traders.
newsitem.headline: Signet up on takeover rumors - traders.

text.p: Signet Banking Corp, a Richmond, Va.-based bank holding company, was up 1-3/4 to 28-7/8 Friday on takeover rumors, Wall Street traders said.

Fueling the rumors were stories in Business Week magazine and American Banker that described the company as a takeover target. Business Week quoted a money manager, who it did not identify, as saying First Union Corp made an offer of $35 share, or $2.1 billion, but was turned down by Signet.
A spokesperson for Signet was not immediately available for comment. Charlotte, N.C.-based First Union declined comment as a matter of policy. First Union was off 1/8 to 67.
